title: Line sketch: Twin Spiraling Vortexes
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: The artwork depicts two large, opposing spiral forms that mirror each other across the page, creating a symmetrical yet dynamic composition. Bold, sweeping in layered colors radiate outward from each vortex center, blending and overlapping to suggest motion. The technique emphasizes energetic, visible strokes that build depth and rhythm within the abstract design (derived from painting #8).
